# Kenmore Veterinary Hospital

> AAHA-accredited veterinary care center in Kenmore, WA offering comprehensive pet wellness, surgical services, dental care, and emergency support.

Kenmore Veterinary Hospital is a full-service animal clinic led by Dr. Julia Mulvaney, providing preventive care, diagnostics, surgery, and specialized services for pets in the Kenmore and surrounding King County area. The hospital emphasizes fear-free, compassionate care with state-of-the-art diagnostic technology.

## Key Topics

## Core Services & Wellness

- [Pet Wellness Care](https://kenmorevet.com/pet-wellness-care): Annual exams, vaccinations, and preventive healthcare services
- [Animal Wellness Center Services](https://kenmorevet.com/animal-wellness-center-services): Preventive care services including dental, surgery, and diagnostics
- [Expert Animal Surgery](https://kenmorevet.com/animal-surgery): Surgical services including spay/neuter and mass removal
- [Professional Pet Dental Care](https://kenmorevet.com/veterinary-dental-specialist): Professional dental cleaning and periodontal disease treatment
- [Senior Pet Care](https://kenmorevet.com/senior-pet-care): Specialized care for senior pets including pain management and acupuncture
- [Pet Nutrition](https://kenmorevet.com/pet-nutrition): Nutritional counseling and personalized diet plans for pets

## Diagnostics & Advanced Technology

- [Digital Radiography](https://kenmorevet.com/digital-radiography): State-of-the-art digital X-ray diagnostic imaging technology
- [Preventative Diagnostic Packages](https://kenmorevet.com/preventative-diagnostic-packages): Age-based screening panels and diagnostic blood work packages

## Emergency & Urgent Care

- [Emergency Services](https://kenmorevet.com/emergency): Emergency services and after-hours pet care support resources
